name: Thelon of Havenwood
title: Thelonite Druid
role: Druid associated with the cultivation of thallids
summary: A Havenwood druid whose fungal creations became central to the Sarpadian elves' struggle.
biography: Thelon is associated with the development of thallids, the fungal beings that could generate saprolings in the declining society of Havenwood.
The elves' attempts to enlist fungal life among their resources were followed by conflicts as the thallids expanded beyond expectations.
His later Time Spiral card recalls the Fallen Empires period rather than depicting an event contemporaneous with the 2006 expansion.

Thelon's connection to the thallids explains how a magical solution to scarcity and conflict could create new uncertainty. The Havenwood elves' relationship to fungal life changed as thallids multiplied and ceased to fit their intended place in elven society.

Thelon's story is separate from Endrek Sahr's work for the Ebon Hand. The thallids were fungal life associated with Havenwood, while thrulls were produced for a different Sarpadian power. Treating them as one experiment would obscure the distinct causes of each collapse.

His Time Spiral legend is a retrospective representation. Wizards' design account explicitly connected Thelon to the earlier Fallen Empires history and included black mana in one ability to suggest a more complicated identity.

featuredCard.significance: A Time Spiral retrospective portrait of the druid connected with Sarpadia's thallids.
